描述_EN: small spots of green glaze was added to the surface of the jar and they had run down during firing, resulting in a pleasing irregular pattern. in the tang dynasty (618-907) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware. this jar was probably a funerary piece, as lead-glazed vessels could poison the user.
描述_ZN: 小斑点的绿色釉料被添加到罐子的表面，它们在烧制过程中流下，形成了令人愉悦的不规则图案。 在唐代（618-907），日常用具通常由石器制成，而埋葬物品则由陶器制成。 这个罐子可能是一件殉葬品，因为铅釉器皿会使使用者中毒。
